title: Remove redundant QUIET_INIT move-picker stage
rationale: Current FayE movepick.cpp still has the redundant QUIET_INIT stage. Stockfish PR #7150 removes only that stage transition and falls directly from exhausted GOOD_CAPTURE into quiet generation, with no intended functional change. This is isolated from prior TT/NNUE experiments and preserves sparse/incremental CPU behavior.
promotion_rule: Do not merge from the small screen. Require non-adverse strength plus credible repeatable efficiency before larger confirmation.
notes: No NNUE architecture or relational-feature change.
